cold_scope: Fresh process, Graph, immutable snapshot and cone-plan cache in each trial. OS file cache is not flushed.
instrumentation: All component timers are inclusive. Top-level phases are disjoint; nested timers must not be summed with parents.

proposal.component_instrumentation: Use an identical timing harness around existing calls, without deleting guards or moving cone plan construction outside the measured path; label nested timers and do not double-count
included: Python startup, original AIG read/compile, initial signature setup and case-bound input/source/tool verification
All existing collector input/CNF/query/result/model/receipt/frame-role hashing and parsing, exact original proof-CNF reconstruction and comparison
Immutable graph capture, complete projected-PI schema checks, COLD cone-plan construction and evaluation; no prebuilt or cross-trial cone cache
Both full original-AIG passes, recipe replay, complete sample construction, deduplication, projection admission and signature append
Normal provenance/model/report JSON emission to fresh per-trial paths
Verification that returned samples, witnesses, admitted rows, decisions and final signatures match the existing correctness reference
invariants: no new models or reordered model sources
all raw failures retained; no automatic retry or case replacement
proposal.next_decision: Only if full pipeline savings survive plan building, all bindings and original replay, consider a separately approved same-model end-to-end pilot; otherwise keep the full reference/default and stop this fast-path performance line.
proposal.objective: Measure exact-cone validation on identical immutable saved model streams without changing SAT models or discovery work
proposal.primary_boundary: monotonic direct-child wall, before launch through exit, for one case saved-record validation/admission pipeline
proposal.reporting: Per-case and paired-sweep wall times and absolute differences; total time across the same six cases; component timing with explicit nesting/unmeasured residual. This measures the saved-record validation pipeline, not end-to-end transform speed or new area gain.

resources.storage: new workspace directory only; existing pilot and correctness outputs immutable

proposal.scheduling: one fresh worker process at a time; fixed case order; first arm alternates by case and reverses in sweep two; wait for unrelated heavy work to finish
proposal.stopping: Finish the 24 preregistered trials, or stop on identity/semantic/capacity/timeout failure and report it without retuning/retrying. No new timed cohort or all55 launch is authorized by this proposal.
proposal.unchanged_upstream_binding_cost: Additionally replay the two upstream model-bearing batch binding validations (_batch and solve layers) before each corresponding collection, using the same recorded artifacts in both arms; include their cost in the primary boundary and report it separately. No solver is invoked.

stop_policy: First integrity, semantic, capacity or timeout failure stops all remaining trials; no automatic resume/retry.
upstream_scope: For each consumed manifest once per case: read_model_batch plus bound_model for all emitted SAT rows (_batch layer), then read_model_batch plus bound_model for every matching saved SAT candidate receipt (solve layer). This replays the two model-binding layers, not solver execution or unrelated proof bookkeeping.
validation_overhead: Reference validation independently reevaluates the original combinational AIG at each saved unique sample and compares the whole returned sample vector; this extra test-only pass is separately timed and included in primary wall.
